# Harness changelog

Changes to prompts, tool descriptions, playbooks and error messages that the improvement loop kept, each with the numbers that kept it, and the ones it dropped. How a change gets here: [improvement-loop.md](improvement-loop.md).

## Tried and dropped

| Proposal | Cause | Change | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| P-001 | `tool/findings_update_coverage/refused: no such file` | When an evidence entry is a path followed by a note, as in 'evidence/runs/x.txt (no WAF)', and the path alone exists, the refusal says so: evidence takes file paths only, and the note goes in the rationale. Today it says only 'no such file'. | tool/findings_update_coverage/refused: no such file: 3.333 → 0.0 records per run (SE of the difference 1.145): shrank; held-out strict recall per item -0.500, 95% CI [-0.731, -0.269]: fell beyond the spread |

## Merged as fixes, not judged

| Proposal | Cause | Change | Why no judge round |
|---|---|---|---|
| P-002 (2026-11-15) | `tool/findings_update_finding/refused: <id> is candidate, and this call doesn't confirm it` | When update_finding carries method with other fields and no status on a finding that isn't confirmed, the other fields are saved and the reply says method was not recorded (it is kept only with status=confirmed, with evidence and reproduction steps). A call with method alone is still refused. | A regression from the confirm-loop fix (82ab380), visible in every targeted trace: the refusal threw away the other fields and the planner resent the call 35-46 times, which collapsed 3 of 8 round-1 candidate runs. Merged on its tests and the 77 records read; a judge round with 2-3 runs a side couldn't add much for its cost. |
